deadline_text_verbatim: Degree programmes with an unlimited number of places -- Call One: November 2, 2025 - February 2, 2026
researcher_notes: First of three calls for unlimited-places English-taught programmes (excl. Medicine). Closed as of retrieval.
scope: unlimited-places English-taught programmes, all eligible applicants

researcher_notes: Second of three calls, same track as Call One above.
scope: unlimited-places English-taught programmes, all eligible applicants

deadline_text_verbatim: Call Three: (only for EU citizens and non EU citizens residing in Italy) June 2 - August 2, 2026
researcher_notes: Third and final call for unlimited-places programmes -- explicitly NOT open to non-EU citizens residing outside Italy, unlike Calls One and Two. Some programmes (named: Pharmaceutical Biotechnologies, Medical Biotechnologies Master's) restrict Call Three the same way even where the general rule might differ. Closed as of retrieval (2 days before this research, 2026-08-21).
scope: unlimited-places English-taught programmes, EU and Italy-resident non-EU applicants only

deadline_text_verbatim: Degree programmes with a limited number of places -- Call One (only for non-EU citizens residing outside Italy): January 7 - March 7, 2026
researcher_notes: For limited-places programmes, the ordering is reversed from the unlimited-places case: non-EU-abroad applicants get the FIRST call rather than being excluded from the last one -- a genuine structural asymmetry between the two programme types, not a copy-paste inconsistency.
scope: limited-places English-taught programmes, non-EU applicants residing outside Italy only

deadline_text_verbatim: Call Two (only for EU citizens and non-EU citizens residing in Italy): March 10 - April 10, 2026
researcher_notes: Second and final call for limited-places programmes.
scope: limited-places English-taught programmes, EU and Italy-resident non-EU applicants only
